svg.title: Integration by parts as two areas in a rectangle
svg.desc: In the u-v plane, the curve v = ln u runs from (1, 0) to (e, 1). The region under the curve, between it and the u-axis from u = 1 to u = e, is shaded green and has area 1: this is the integral of v du. The region to the left of the curve, between it and the v-axis from v = 0 to v = 1, is shaded blue and has area e − 1, about 1.718: this is the integral of u dv. Together the two regions fill the dashed rectangle from (0, 0) to (e, 1), whose area is uv = e. So the integral of v du equals uv minus the integral of u dv.

text.tspan: area to the left of the curve
Together they fill the e-by-1 rectangle: ∫ v du + ∫ u dv = uv = e · 1 − 1 · 0
So ∫ from 1 to e of ln u du = e − (e − 1) = 1: integration by parts reads the same picture.
